label.description: Visible label; also names the stepper buttons.

onValueChange.description: Called on every committed step, scrub, or valid typed draft.

step.description: Increment; its precision also sets default fraction digits.

largeStep.description: Distance for PageUp, PageDown, and Shift with an arrow.

prefix.description: Text before the number, such as "$".

suffix.description: Text after the number; a function can pluralize, e.g. n => n === 1 ? " seat" : " seats".

scrub.description: Drag the label sideways to change the value.

locale.description: Formatting locale, fixed so server and client match.

size.description: Control height, type size, and default width (164, 196, or 228px).

limitHint.description: Note beside the label when a press meets a limit (about 1.5s) or a typed value passes one. Defaults to "Max 10 seats" using the prefix and suffix; false hides it.
